scope.objective: Teach Symthaea source-grounded Leptos 0.8 component, reactivity, routing, context, async browser and interaction-state patterns across existing Symthaea UI applications.
limitations: Source presence is not proof that a pattern compiles on the pinned lockfile.
Official API documentation must be matched to the resolved minor release before promotion.
CSR source patterns must not be presented as SSR or hydration guidance.
Browser lifecycle and cleanup behavior requires browser tests.
Routing, shared context, reducers, and authorization patterns are taken from the existing Muse UI and require independent compile/browser verification before promotion.

patterns.title: Function component and view composition
patterns.concept: Define a root UI unit with #[component] and return an IntoView tree from view!.
use_when: A page or reusable UI unit has a clear semantic responsibility.
The component owns a coherent subtree and its local state.
avoid: Do not collapse a whole complex application into one unstructured component when independently testable regions are needed.
tests_required: Compile on the exact Cargo.lock resolution.
Assert the rendered semantic landmarks in a browser.

patterns.title: Local reactive state with RwSignal
patterns.concept: Use RwSignal for local state that is read and updated by multiple parts of a component.
use_when: State is local to a component owner.
The view should update when the signal changes.
avoid: Do not reach for global shared state before a real ownership boundary requires it.
Avoid cloning large state when read guards or update closures are adequate.
tests_required: Check updates propagate to the expected DOM nodes.
Check no stale or disposed signal is accessed.

patterns.title: Tracked reads versus untracked reads
patterns.concept: A tracked getter subscribes the current reactive observer; an untracked getter returns a value without creating that dependency.
use_when: Use tracked reads for reactive dependencies.
Use untracked reads when the algorithm intentionally samples current state without resubscribing.
avoid: Never assume get_untracked will cause an Effect to rerun when the signal changes.
Document the retry or polling event that causes the next untracked sample.
tests_required: A tracked-read test must show rerun after set().
An untracked-read test must show no implicit subscription.

patterns.title: Effects for browser and external side effects
patterns.concept: Effect::new runs after synchronous work and tracks reactive values read through tracked accessors; it is for side effects rather than derived state synchronization.
use_when: Connect reactive state to browser APIs or external systems.
Start mount-scoped subscriptions when their lifetime matches the owner.
avoid: Do not use Effects merely to synchronize one signal from another; prefer derived signals or Memo.
Do not assume an untracked read creates a dependency.
A spawned async loop needs an explicit cancellation or owner-lifetime plan if its owner can be disposed.
tests_required: Verify effect rerun and cleanup semantics.
Unmount the owner and verify spawned work is cancelled or harmless.

patterns.title: Client-side async work with spawn_local
patterns.concept: Use spawn_local for browser-local asynchronous tasks and always resolve success and failure into explicit UI state.
use_when: A CSR interaction awaits fetch, WebSocket or browser-only work.
The task runs on the browser's local execution context.
avoid: Do not silently drop errors.
Do not permit duplicate submissions when a request is in flight.
Do not leave sending/loading state stuck after early returns or cancellation.
tests_required: Successful and failing fixture requests.
Duplicate-submit negative control.
Owner-disposal/cancellation test.

patterns.title: Keyed list rendering with For
patterns.concept: Use For with a stable key so list items are associated with their logical identity during updates.
patterns.code: {turn.text} } />
use_when: Render collections whose item identity is stable over updates.
avoid: An array index is only acceptable when the collection is append-only or reorder/delete semantics are explicitly absent; otherwise key by stable entity ID.
tests_required: Append, replace, reorder and delete tests for the chosen identity model.

patterns.title: Typed NodeRef for DOM-backed rendering
patterns.concept: Use a typed NodeRef to access a concrete DOM node after it is mounted, then react to the relevant signal changes.
use_when: A browser API needs a concrete DOM element such as Canvas.
avoid: Avoid using NodeRef as a substitute for declarative rendering when a normal Leptos view can express the UI.
tests_required: Verify the node exists after mount and is unavailable or cleaned up after owner disposal.

patterns.title: Keep WASM UI behind a typed transport boundary
patterns.concept: Keep the lightweight Leptos CSR crate dependent on the service HTTP/WebSocket interface rather than linking the entire Symthaea cognitive engine into the browser bundle.
use_when: The cognitive engine is too heavy for a WASM frontend.
A service process can own long-running cognition and expose a narrower wire protocol.
avoid: Avoid duplicating server wire structures unless a separate shared view-types contract is justified.
Treat response JSON as untrusted and validate dimensions, variants and lengths before allocating.
tests_required: Contract fixtures for query/status/telemetry.
Negative malformed-payload tests.
Compatibility tests against the exact daemon wire version.

patterns.title: Declarative nested route composition
patterns.concept: Use Router as the navigation owner, Routes as the active route switch, Route with path! macros for typed path declarations, and A for client-side links. Read the current location when active navigation styling depends on the route.
use_when: A CSR application has multiple addressable pages.
Navigation should update the URL and preserve a shared application shell.
avoid: Do not implement route changes as ad hoc local booleans when the URL should be canonical.
Do not put long-lived media or stateful controllers inside a route subtree if navigation should preserve them.
tests_required: Direct-load each route.
Verify browser back/forward and active navigation styling.
Verify route fallback for unknown paths.

patterns.title: Typed context for shared state without prop drilling
patterns.concept: Create the shared state at an owning root, provide it into the reactive owner tree, and retrieve it from descendant components with a typed use_context call.
use_when: Several route components need the same cohesive state object.
The state belongs to a known ancestor owner and descendants should share it.
avoid: Do not use context as an untyped global service locator.
Do not provide independent mutable copies when one shared signal owner is required.
Do not unwrap missing context in a reusable library component without documenting the provider requirement.
tests_required: Mount the descendant beneath the provider and assert shared updates.
Mount without a provider and verify the documented failure or optional-context behavior.
Verify context is scoped to the expected owner tree.

patterns.title: Derived state with Memo and a single source of truth
patterns.concept: Represent values that can be computed from existing reactive state as derived reactive values, rather than duplicating mutable state that can drift out of sync.
use_when: A view needs a derived selection or computed representation of source state.
Several outputs must remain consistent with one source-of-truth signal.
A derivation is costly enough or shared enough to benefit from memoization.
avoid: Do not store both a selected entity and its derived category as independently mutable signals.
Do not introduce Memo overhead for a trivial one-off expression without evidence.
Ensure fallbacks represent an explicit valid state rather than hiding an impossible mapping failure.
tests_required: Changing the source signal updates derived values.
Unchanged derived output does not trigger unnecessary downstream work (where observable).
Missing catalog mapping is handled explicitly.

patterns.title: Programmatic navigation after a state transition
patterns.concept: Use use_navigate within a route component to obtain a typed navigation callback and move to the destination after the state transition has been applied.
use_when: A successful user action changes application state and then routes to the appropriate page.
Navigation is part of a completed workflow, not just a static anchor.
avoid: Do not navigate before required state is committed if the destination immediately reads that state.
Do not hide failed operations by navigating away before surfacing their error.
tests_required: Trigger the workflow and assert both state change and final route.
Inject a failed operation and verify navigation does not falsely signal success.

patterns.title: Pure reducer for browser-independent interaction state
patterns.concept: Keep complex interaction state transitions in a pure Rust reducer that maps typed events to new state and explicit effects. This separates state-machine correctness from browser side effects.
use_when: A complex widget has transitions that can be tested without a DOM.
Late async/browser events must be rejected using epochs or generation IDs.
State transitions should be deterministic and replayable.
avoid: Do not embed network or DOM side effects in the reducer.
Do not mutate the audio element separately from the reducer if the reducer owns playback state.
Do not accept events whose load epoch does not match the active source.
tests_required: Pure unit tests for every event/phase transition.
Out-of-order old-epoch event negative controls.
Replay identical event sequences and compare states/effects.

patterns.title: Keep long-lived browser resources outside route lifetimes
patterns.concept: Place a persistent DOM resource such as an audio element outside the Routes subtree when it must survive route changes, and share its typed NodeRef through app-owned state.
patterns.code:
view! {
// This element remains mounted across route switches. "Page not found"

}>
}
use_when: Audio/video/media contexts must persist across pages.
A persistent controller or resource must outlive a route-specific view.
avoid: Do not keep all page content mounted just to preserve one resource.
Do not let the persistent node outlive the reactive owner that manages its signals.
Do not let route handlers mutate a persistent DOM resource outside the shared state/reducer contract.
tests_required: Start playback then navigate across routes and assert the same audio element stays mounted.
Verify no duplicate audio element or duplicate event handlers are created.
Navigate away and back and verify state remains coherent.

patterns.title: Adapt browser events into a typed reducer with epoch guards
patterns.concept: Treat DOM/browser events as observations and dispatch typed events into a reducer; tag each event with the load epoch currently owned by the active resource so late events from a superseded source can be ignored.
use_when: A browser API emits delayed or out-of-order events.
The state model needs to reject stale events after a new resource has been loaded.
avoid: Do not mutate the reactive state directly in multiple independent event handlers.
Do not trust event arrival order as proof that the event belongs to the current resource.
tests_required: Supersede one source then deliver old events and assert no state change.
Deliver current-epoch events and assert expected state update.
Exercise pause, seek, ended and error events.

patterns.title: Fail-closed explicit authorization before import
patterns.concept: Represent authorization as an Option that begins unset; do not choose a default when the choice is consequential. Validate that the user made an explicit choice before starting the async import request.
use_when: An operation requires a clear consent/authorization basis.
There is no safe default between materially different permission states.
avoid: Do not default authorization to true or select the most permissive choice.
Do not start async mutation before required authorization and metadata are validated.
Do not confuse UI selection with server-side authorization enforcement.
tests_required: Unset authorization prevents request dispatch.
Each explicit authorization choice is encoded in the request.
Server independently verifies authorization; UI gating is not the security boundary.

patterns.title: Asynchronous component initialization with visible loading and failure states
patterns.concept: Use an Effect to launch component-scoped browser async work and write distinct loading, success and failure states into reactive signals.
use_when: A component needs to fetch supporting content on mount.
The page should render immediately with a visible loading state and later resolve to success or failure.
avoid: Do not leave the UI in an ambiguous blank state while awaiting data.
Do not swallow fetch errors.
If the component can unmount before the future resolves, define owner cleanup/cancellation or prove the captured state remains safe.
tests_required: Controlled fixture for success, empty and error responses.
Unmount-during-fetch test.
Verify loading status transitions and no stale update.

source_observed_not_compiled: Exact source path and blob SHA.
reference_checked_not_compiled: Exact Leptos or dependency docs version and API reference.
compiled: Exact Rust toolchain, Cargo.lock digest and successful cargo check.
unit_tested: Exact head and passing unit/property test receipt.
browser_verified: Pinned Chromium build, deterministic fixture, browser trace, screenshots and independent assertions.

promotion_policy.rule: A pattern is never promoted based on generated code alone. Unknown or stale framework versions remain quarantined until revalidated.
